summary: 0042E740 returns the 6D0h-byte plane tuning singleton cached in DAT_00F87440, built once by the __thiscall constructor 007E2A20. The loader runs Scripts\global\luaMW_init.lua for its constant and DEG/KMH helpers and Scripts\datatables\PlaneGlobals.lua for the data, then copies 423 distinct key paths out of the global PlaneGlobals table into 436 offsets with 439 stores. There are no constructor defaults. 007D213C is the only write into the singleton from any of the 141 call sites and it is an idempotent clamp to 1.0f that the installed value 1.5 makes unreachable.

corrections.was: The tuning object 0042E740 returns is 6D0h bytes loaded from Scripts\global\luaMW_init.lua by 007E2A20
corrections.is: 007E2A20 runs luaMW_init.lua at 007E2AE9 but reads no key from it; luaMW_init.lua defines only constants and the DEG/KMH helpers. Every key comes from the global PlaneGlobals table defined by Scripts\datatables\PlaneGlobals.lua, run at 007E2B5D and fetched at 007E2BB4 through the key string at 00d085f4.
corrections.evidence: 007E2AE9 and 007E2B5D literal paths; 00b67980 at 007E2B98 then 00b67800 at 007E2BB4

corrections.was: The Accel path writes 1.0f back into tuning[+31Ch]. It is a per-class read mutating shared tuning; whether that is a guard or a defect is not established here.
corrections.is: It is a guard. The write is on the AccelCheatMul <= 1.0f branch only and stores the same 1.0f constant it compared against, so it is idempotent and can never scale a value that was already above 1.0f. +31c, +320 and +334 are read by 007D1F70 alone across all 141 callers, and 007D213C is the only write into the singleton from any of them. With the installed AccelCheatMul = 1.5 the branch is never taken.

call_site_survey.method: forward walk of each caller's listing from every CALL 0x0042e740, following EAX through register moves and stack spills; alias set reset at each getter call and caller-saved registers dropped at every other call. Lower bound: an offset reached after the pointer is passed to another function is not counted.
